owner_intent: Financial-only clustering for M2, PIT snapshots and integration with external market results for M3

universe.identity: historical security_id intervals, with issuer linkage and delisted securities
universe.initial_scope: non-financial issuers with verified historical classification
universe.statement_scope: consolidated or verified issuer without subsidiaries
universe.selection: complete eligible feature vector at each snapshot; disclose exclusions and coverage

proposed_feature_contracts.basis: recomputed TTM with compatible weighted-share and earnings-adjustment basis
dated raw price and compatible EPS TTM; nonpositive EPS returns null
dated raw price, parent common equity and historical common shares/events
annual named VAS reported-net-profit variant; carry only after source availability
annual named VAS sensitivity; explicit total-assets-t accrual denominator, not strict original reproduction
annual EM Z-double-prime with constant 3.25 and reviewed EBIT; no distress threshold

preprocessing_proposed.missing: no imputation, zero-fill, cross-vintage filling or future backfill
preprocessing_proposed.scaler: standardization fitted on development observations only, frozen for holdout
preprocessing_proposed.pca: none for baseline; separate comparator only after review
preprocessing_proposed.outliers: report and review; no silent winsorization or deletion

static_baseline_proposed.k_rationale: preregistered three-group financial baseline proposal; not selected using returns or holdout outcomes
static_baseline_proposed.minimum_sample_rationale: proposed operational floor of ten observations per cluster; requires methodological review, not a statistical sufficiency claim

required_external_market_handoff: versioned model/protocol config and artifact manifest hashes
security_id/exchange identity intervals and issuer mapping
observed calendar and decision timestamp/timezone policy
development/holdout split and monthly snapshot keys
raw-unadjusted close price with units and corporate-action/share history
market cluster assignments and eligibility per decision snapshot
M3 return basis, transaction-cost assumptions and methodology approval
